signal_attribution.reasoning_chain: Negative GEX (-$312M) plus VIX backwardation (26.8, VX2/VX1 -2.6%) puts the market in the Explosive regime, where bullish trend following backtests best (65.5%). Extreme crowd fear (CAG 1.07, Fear z=+2.22) adds a contrarian bullish edge. Bearish headline flow (P/C 1.271) is mostly SPX/SPXW multileg hedging, while single-name deep ITM calls in AMZN, META and AAPL show accumulation. Because regime confidence is only 22%, flow is nominally bearish, the 10Y is 4.85%, and the next session is a thin half-day, conviction stays medium-low (38 intraday, 52 next-day, 62 for 30-day) with ranges widened and targets anchored to the SPX 7150/7250 walls.
